prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: The multi-national firm is planning (A) / to shift their primary headquarters (B) / from London to Singapore next year. (C) / No Error (D)
options: from London to Singapore next year.
explanation: 'Firm' is treated as singular here ('is planning'), so the possessive pronoun must be 'its primary headquarters', not 'their'.
